overview: The Medford City Council and Community Development Board held a joint special meeting to advance the Medford Square zoning process and the City Hall parking lot redevelopment project. The bodies finalized the public hearing for the City Hall overlay district and established a zoning meeting calendar through June 2026.

items.title: Meeting Records
items.summary: Approved the records of the special joint meeting held on March 25, 2026.

items.title: Public Hearing: Medford Square Zoning (Paper 26023)
items.summary: The City Council voted to close its public hearing on the Medford Square zoning amendments, while the Community Development Board continued its hearing to April 15 to incorporate final technical changes. Public testimony addressed design reviews, urban tree canopy protections, and the need for group gathering spaces in the square.

items.title: Public Hearing: City Hall Overlay District/Transom Project (Paper 26058)
items.summary: The Community Development Board recommended approval of the overlay district with amendments to align use tables with current Medford Square drafts, and both bodies voted to close their respective public hearings. The proposal by Transom Real Estate includes 300 residential units, a parking garage with 150 spaces reserved for the city, and a ground-floor urban grocery store.

items.title: Zoning Meeting Schedule (Paper 26052)
items.summary: Approved an updated meeting calendar through June 2026 to coordinate upcoming public information sessions and joint hearings for the Tufts University and Boston Avenue zoning phases.
